screens.description: Notification overlay renders in a separate frameless BrowserWindow (src/notification-main.tsx) when a new prompt scan event fires. Cross-cut guard for §9.1.
screens.tbd: (P0.5.2) Skipped under OMT_QA_CAPTURE_MODE=1 — the notification BrowserWindow is not created in capture mode (creates CDP target ambiguity). To capture this screen the orchestrator would need to (a) launch Electron WITHOUT OMT_QA_CAPTURE_MODE, (b) trigger a notification, (c) tab-switch to the notification window, (d) capture via CDP — but agent-browser's CDP screenshot is unreliable in multi-tab scenarios (the original P0.5 blocker). U1-VR can decide to either drop this canonical screen, add a separate launch mode that captures only the notification window solo, or accept manual capture. Tracked separately.

screens.name: renderer-dashboard
screens.description: Renderer-only twin: dashboard view rendered against mock window.api (src/main.tsx). Captured via qa-launch-renderer.sh + agent-browser open <vite-url>, with viewport pinned to 400x640 (`agent-browser set viewport`). U1-VR-d findings: orchestrator now pins viewport so PNG dimensions are stable, but pixel data is NOT byte-deterministic — src/main.tsx mock uses Math.random() (lines 165-166) for the prompt-heatmap mock data, so each render produces different heatmap counts/colors. The Electron-headed dashboard-all-default already covers the same layout deterministically. Renderer-dashboard PNGs are kept under /renderer/ as INFORMATIONAL smoke-checks (not byte-equal regression targets); regression verification should rely on the canonical/ Electron captures. To make renderer-dashboard byte-equal in the future, replace Math.random() in src/main.tsx with a seeded PRNG.

screens.name: renderer-settings
screens.description: Renderer-only twin: settings view. Reached by triggering the onNavigateTo('settings') IPC mock (App.tsx:53-62).
screens.tbd: (U1-VR-d) Permanently OUT-OF-SCOPE for the dashboard.css decomposition baseline: `.settings-section` is styled in src/App.css (lines 122-141), NOT in src/components/dashboard/dashboard.css. The Settings view contains no CSS rules that would be touched by the decomposition refactor, so capturing it adds no regression-detection value for this epic. Additionally, the mock onNavigateTo in src/main.tsx does not expose a `_trigger` hook — adding one is unnecessary scope creep. Re-evaluate when the App.css decomposition epic begins.
